postInstall: Run: npx shadcn@latest init -y (if not already initialized)

Run: npx pnpm@9.15.0 dlx shadcn@latest create --preset "https://ui.shadcn.com/init?base=base&style=vega&baseColor=neutral&theme=neutral&iconLibrary=phosphor&font=nunito-sans&menuAccent=subtle&menuColor=inverted&radius=small&template=next" --template next
Then run: npx pnpm@9.15.0 dlx shadcn@latest add --all --yes
